source_tests: HumanEval+ (EvalPlus, Liu et al. 2023, Apache-2.0, https://github.com/evalplus/evalplus), HumanEval/4 from https://huggingface.co/datasets/evalplus/humanevalplus
statement: Given a non-empty list of floating-point numbers, compute the mean absolute deviation around the mean: the average of the absolute differences between each element and the arithmetic mean of the list.
